provenance.purpose: Natural ANT material stratigraphy lifecycle, exposure, burial, nodules and behavior parity.
provenance.preparation: Fresh default AntController instances; deterministic LCG; audio remains Off; no forced births or contacts.
provenance.behaviorParity: Same seed/controller with MaterialStratigraphy lifecycle replaced by a no-op. TrailPlateBirth, surface, pheromone, gait and controller are unchanged.

thresholdAudit.purpose: Assess whether proposed nodule qualification thresholds are reachable in natural seeded history; not a final performance run.
